title: Disposable plastic tablecloth in a roll
text:
Disposable plastic tablecloth in a roll. This stuff is really thin... but I LOVE LOVE LOVED that I could cut to fit individual tables... and then roll up to toss. You might be able to wipe and leave on tables for a season if you had a screen house or such (?). Otherwise, I was really happy to use one time at our annual family seafood boil. *FYI... it is obviously super thin plastic... it will and does tear... but not more than expected.
UPDATE: 7/2018.... Soooo... I came back to order more and found that my original box had "423 feet." Now, it's less than a quarter of that at 100 feet. Eh. As wonderful as this roll of table clothes is... bring back the bigger quantity. Have to dock a star for that...
